moon_phases.title: Moon phases
moon_phases.desc_new_moon: The moon is not visible — Hilal sighting begins after sunset.
moon_phases.desc_waxing_crescent: A thin crescent appears in the western sky after sunset.
moon_phases.desc_first_quarter: Half the moon is illuminated. Visible in the afternoon and evening.
moon_phases.desc_waxing_gibbous: More than half lit — the moon rises before sunset.
moon_phases.desc_full_moon: The full disc is illuminated and visible all night.
moon_phases.desc_waning_gibbous: More than half lit but shrinking — the moon rises after sunset.
moon_phases.desc_last_quarter: Half the moon is illuminated. Visible from midnight to morning.
moon_phases.desc_waning_crescent: A thin crescent in the eastern sky before sunrise.
moon_phases.verse_yunus_explain: The moon is one of Allah's signs. He made it a light and ordained for it phases by which people know the count of years and the reckoning of time.
moon_phases.splitting_explain: The splitting of the moon is a visible miracle granted to the Prophet ﷺ — the people of Makkah saw the moon cleave into two halves and rejoin. Narrated in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim from Anas, Ibn Mas'ud and Ibn Abbas. It is a proof of his prophethood and a sign foretelling the nearness of the Hour.
moon_phases.verse_baqarah_explain: The new crescents are timings for people and for Hajj. By them the lunar months are known: Ramadan for fasting, the months of Hajj, and the timings of every act of worship in a Muslim's life.
moon_phases.importance_hijri: The Hijri month begins with sighting the new crescent after sunset.
moon_phases.importance_ramadan: Fasting Ramadan and Eid al-Fitr are timed by sighting the crescents of Sha'ban, Ramadan and Shawwal.
moon_phases.importance_hajj: The Hajj season falls in Dhul-Hijjah, beginning with its new crescent.
moon_phases.importance_ayyam_al_bid: The White Days (13–15) are the brightest nights and are recommended for voluntary fasting.
moon_phases.sighting_when_value: Just after sunset (around the Maghrib prayer).
moon_phases.sighting_where_value: Low on the western horizon, where the sun has just set.
moon_phases.sighting_how_value: With the naked eye in a clear sky, away from city lights.
